objective: Implement the CoS half of the read-only Supervisor Shunt transport. Read AGENTS.md first. Add a narrow operation to the existing owner-only Unix control service that runs exactly one read-only Codex scout/reviewer request from the CoS app process, so macOS uses one seatbelt boundary rather than trying to nest a second boundary inside the existing model command sandbox. The operation must be purpose-specific: no caller-supplied executable, shell command, or arbitrary argv. Validate role is scout/reviewer, canonical workspace is inside ~/Downloads/Projects, model/reasoning are bounded and valid, prompt/body/output are bounded, and any output schema is a canonical regular JSON file inside Projects. Resolve the shipped Codex executable from trusted CoS configuration/application state. Apply one native Codex macOS sandbox around the whole child process: source workspace is readable and not writable, only a broker-created 0700 per-run runtime/output directory is writable, required network remains available, and real ~/.codex/auth.json is readable but cannot be modified or unlinked. Do not copy or log credential bytes. The currently selected named Projects profile is writable and no named read-only profile exists, so investigate the supported sandbox-state mechanism or another native Codex single-seatbelt construction. The agent's own generated command sandbox must not add a second seatbelt when the whole process is already constrained. Return only bounded final output and exact usage/event material needed by Shunt; clean broker-owned temp state. Preserve existing control task API semantics. Add focused tests for validation, fixed command/policy construction, and containment invariants. Do not edit installed runtime/config or arsenal. Do not spawn agents.
constraints: Expose no generic direct command broker.
Keep source changes inside owned files.
